chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) to Abu Dharr (may Allah have mercy on him), when he was exiled to ar-Rabadhah.

key_terms.أَبِي ذَرٍّ: Abu Dharr, a prominent companion of the Prophet known for his asceticism
key_terms.الرَّبَذَةِ: Ar-Rabadhah, a place of exile for Abu Dharr near Mecca
key_terms.لَمَّا: When, indicating the temporal context of the narration

ai.seo_question: When did Imam Ali address Abu Dharr regarding his exile?
ai.summary: This introductory phrase sets the historical context for Imam Ali’s correspondence with Abu Dharr al-Ghifari during his exile to ar-Rabadhah, a period marked by political tension and the early Umayyad consolidation of power. It highlights the scholarly tradition of viewing this event as a testament to Abu Dharr’s steadfastness in truth and Ali’s recognition of his integrity amidst the shifting tides of the Caliphate.
